claims.claim: At renewal, the driver must confirm that their eyesight meets the minimum standard.
claims.quote: To renew their entitlement, they must make a legal declaration that they can meet the eyesight standards required to drive and confirm whether they have any listed medical conditions.
claims.note: The consultation describes the current legal self-declaration at renewal.

claims.claim: At renewal, the driver must confirm that no medical condition prevents driving.
claims.quote: To renew their entitlement, they must make a legal declaration that they can meet the eyesight standards required to drive and confirm whether they have any listed medical conditions.
claims.note: The applicant confirms whether listed medical conditions exist, not that no condition exists.

claims.claim: DVLA may require medical evidence after a condition has been declared.
claims.quote: Your application may need further information from a healthcare professional, depending on your condition.
claims.note: The source says further healthcare information may be needed depending on the condition.
